name: Fishing Is My Love Language
title: Men's Fishing – Fishing Is My Love Language Socks
story: Fishing is my love language, talking isn't: fishing socks for the angler who says more with a cast than a conversation, a stocking stuffer for dad, grandpa or the guy who is on the water before sunrise, wrapped for Christmas or Father's Day.

The print is a bass in sunglasses lounging in a striped beach chair next to a fishing rod, under FISHING IS MY LOVE LANGUAGE. in bold green slab capitals and TALKING ISN'T. in gold, on cream. The art matches our Fishing Is My Love Language crewneck and hoodie, so the socks make a set with the shirt.

The joke lands with the quiet fisherman and with whoever lives with him: he will happily drive two hours to a boat ramp but not to a dinner party. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed to order, an easy gift for the angler who already owns more lures than socks.
joke_a: The man who goes quiet at dinner and talkative at the boat ramp has found his love language. The Fishing Is My Love Language Socks from Graphic Tees Co. print the confession on the leg with a bass in sunglasses taking it easy in a beach chair, so the joke reads on the dock and at the breakfast table.
ink: the green, gold and cream print
source: Fishing Is My Love Language hoodie
